Due to a permanent communication barrier, a direct data link between Node Alpha and Node Beta is unavailable.
Furthermore, due to a mandatory routing protocol, exactly one of the following two communication channels must be incorporated into the inspection circuit: the channel between Node Beta and Node Gamma, or the channel between Node Gamma and Node Delta.

The objective is to determine the minimal-latency inspection circuit that visits every node precisely once before returning to the origin node.
